high_value_findings.finding: Genesis produced large amounts of low-quality proposal output before pipeline narrowing, model escalation, schema validation and explicit human accept/reject gates. User acceptance then became a reward signal.
high_value_findings.transfer: Separate proposal generation rate, syntactic validity, technical validity, scientific usefulness and user acceptance. Human approval is a gate/feedback event, not proof of correctness.

high_value_findings.finding: Unrelated idle thoughts could resolve hypotheses, while later confirmed/refuted findings were intentionally broadcast back into deep thought and Genesis. Without relevance/provenance controls, a bad resolution can become a self-reinforcing cognitive fact.
high_value_findings.transfer: Empirical feedback loops require relevance gates, independent result provenance, contradiction/refutation preservation and contamination cleanup before broadcast.

high_value_findings.finding: Multiple reward/gating/state paths were source-reported as inverted, frozen, disconnected or firing into nonexistent channels while higher-level behavior continued.
high_value_findings.transfer: Autonomous-system health needs channel-level effectiveness tests and sentinel metrics; process liveness does not prove reward/gate semantics are functioning.

high_value_findings.finding: Hypothesis extraction truncated causal claims and the UI showed a default confidence before testing. Later concrete confirmed/refuted findings were injected into cognition.
high_value_findings.transfer: Preserve full claim text, distinguish priors/defaults from posterior evidence, and broadcast concrete result identity/status rather than only aggregate accuracy.

high_value_findings.finding: Build/distribution surfaces changed rapidly; an advertised registry was empty, a screenshot exposed an IP, and hosting endpoints migrated.
high_value_findings.transfer: Release validation includes artifact existence, endpoint epoching, secret/IP/metadata redaction and continuous multi-target builds.

high_value_findings.finding: Project-history/timeline/team and philosophical certainty claims were corrected toward a longer timeline, broader attribution and open-question framing; Experiment Lab performance/novelty claims remain documentation assertions here.
high_value_findings.transfer: Newer explicit provenance corrections supersede older repository narrative, but cross-source owner statements remain separate until reconciled; novelty/performance language requires independent validation.

negative_results_preserved: 119 historical Genesis proposals were purged as garbage.
AURA reflection loops spammed without rate limiting/dedup.
Reward/gating/state channels could be inverted, frozen, disconnected or dead while services remained alive.
An empty registry was advertised as a release destination.
A public screenshot exposed an IP address.
Unresolved hypotheses displayed default confidence as if tested.
measurement_boundary: All source-reported counts, rates, energy values, fix totals, performance and novelty claims were not independently reproduced in this pass.

earned_work.reason: No row-level earned-work overlap audit was performed.

next_falsifiers: Score autonomous proposals separately for schema validity, implementation validity, novelty/usefulness, duplicate rate and user approval.
Inject unrelated evidence into hypothesis resolution and verify relevance gates prevent status changes and downstream broadcast.
Unit-test every reward/gating channel for sign, reachability, state change and cold-start behavior.
Represent hypothesis prior/confidence/result as separate typed fields and test UI cannot display priors as measured confidence.
Run release preflight that scans images/logs/configs for IPs/secrets and validates advertised artifact endpoints before publication.
